title: Basket Accelerator on Marlowe Rewards Points for Fulfilment Orders
content:
When Marlowe Rewards points are credited on a reservation fulfilment order that never earned them, a large basket earns a basket accelerator. The accelerator is larger when the member has earned regularly in recent months.

## Rate note

| Qualifying spend of the order | Member's earning entries posted in the 6 months ending on the handling date | Accelerator added to the multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 150.00 or more | at least 3 | 0.20 |
| 150.00 or more | fewer than 3 | 0.10 |
| under 150.00 | any | none |

In the 6-month count, an entry dated exactly 6 months before the handling date does not count.

The accelerator is added to the multiplier the qualifying spend is multiplied by, before the product is rounded to a whole point.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 20 September 2025)

| Qualifying spend | Earning entries dated | Count | Accelerator |
|---|---|---|---|
| 150.00 | 21 March, 2 June, 30 August 2025 | 3 | 0.20 |
| 150.00 | 20 March, 2 June, 30 August 2025 | 2 (20 March does not count) | 0.10 |
| 149.99 | five entries in the window | 5 | none |
